next.reason: 1985 GR5: USE procedures run 'after completion of the standard input-output exception routine upon the unsuccessful execution of an input-output operation unless an AT END or INVALID KEY phrase takes precedence', with cases a-e for file-name-1, INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O, EXTEND, each excepting files named by file-name-1 in another USE. 2023 §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 restates this and a-e word for word; its exception-checking PERFORM precondition always holds for 1985 programs (no such PERFORM exists). The file-name-1 precedence is also §2023:14.9.49.4 GR5, and the AT END / INVALID KEY precedence is stated as 'Any other applicable exception processing statements are not executed' in §2023:14.9.30.4 GR24 and 'any applicable exception processing statements are not executed' in §2023:9.1.14 GR2. Same.
